# Picard Relay

> Small Node.js + SQLite relay for exact approved, bounded AI requests and durable saved results. The current live-provider contract is Groq openai/gpt-oss-20b, one call per grant, no tools/execution/retries/paid fallback. This is not an autonomous coding agent or general task board.

## Pick an entry point
- No account or provider: Node 24, then `npm run demo` for a terminal-only synthetic request.
- Local interface: `npm run preview:v1` opens the printed loopback address with disposable synthetic data; stop it with Ctrl+C.
- Enrolled host: follow [Operations](docs/OPERATIONS.md) and [V1 workflow](docs/V1.md). An offline preview is not a production installation, and there is no one-command production installer.
- Integration: read the [API reference](docs/API.md) and [workspace contract](docs/workspace-contract.json); the owner's private Board is not bundled.

## V1 workspace
- [V1 workflow and acceptance](docs/V1.md): ordinary requests, exact approval, durable progress, inert artifacts and local reviews.
- [Structured workspace contract](docs/workspace-contract.json): routes, schemas, limits, persistence and unsupported behaviors.

## Interpretation
Top-level src is the offline/preview tree. experimental/runtime-control/src is the complete signed-runtime source. Their roles differ; do not assume a root source edit updates an enrolled host. GitHub signs/publishes source; separately enrolled hosts install it. Completed means saved response, not correct/executed/deployed/accepted work. Free-policy enrollment is retained configuration evidence, not a current billing check. Uncertain invocations remain spent and must not be automatically replayed. Older checkpoint documents are historical; use the current index, actual source/tests and dated host evidence.

- [Unattended GitHub dispatch](experimental/compute-broker/UNATTENDED.md): merged opt-in owner CI requests, ephemeral repository token, exact MCP dispatch and no automatic retries; dated live evidence is linked.
- [Coding-agent workflow](experimental/compute-broker/CODING-WORKFLOW.md): worker v2 checks root, updater, signed runtime, real sockets, broker normal/jitless and docs for one exact public commit; read-only collection returns every group result, including known failures. Worker-v1 broker-only receipts remain readable.
